name: Bakbakkar
overview: Bakbakkar was a male Levite noted in Scripture as one of those carried into exile. His identification with the tribe of Levi situates him within the priestly and religious duties of Israel. Beyond his tribal affiliation and gender, the biblical record offers limited additional details about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Bakbakkar is a proper name meaning 'investigator.' This meaning does not appear to have been given directly by God but reflects a characteristic that may relate to his role or identity. The name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 9:15.
familyAndRelationships: Bakbakkar is explicitly identified as a descendant of Levi, linking him to the priestly tribe of Israel. Scripture does not provide further details about his family or other relationships beyond this tribal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Bakbakkar's significance lies in his inclusion among the Levites who were taken into exile, highlighting the continuity of the Levitical line even during periods of national judgment and displacement. His mention in 1 Chronicles 9:15 underscores the preservation of the priestly heritage and the faithfulness of God's people amid exile. This brief record serves as a reminder of God's ongoing covenant with the tribe of Levi through all circumstances.
